status: Static archive/reproduction review passed; no inference, fitting, numerical rerun or file collection performed

native_dependency_closure.limit: System/compiler headers and libraries are not copied; compiler/CPU metadata is a separate environment receipt. Inactive CUDA/scalar implementation branches are not part of this binary.

output_integrity: Runner verifies frozen inputs before and after each phase; accumulates and rehashes every previous phase stream/created artifact before the next phase and at completion. Archive collector independently repeats these output checks.
reproduction_limits: Fresh compiler and CPU can change exact executable and floating-point bytes; new run must bind new binaries and pass fixed numeric gates.
A failed run cannot reuse the same outputs; preserve failure and create a separately versioned rerun.
Full model training or full-review generation is not performed by this diagnostic.
Fitted classifier coefficients/intercept are deliberately not retained; fitting is reproducible from frozen feature matrices, sidecars, masks and native source.
Static command review is not a second end-to-end rerun of the live model experiment.
